bio.text: August Pfluger represents Texas's 11th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives and chairs the Republican Study Committee.
He graduated from the U.S. Air Force Academy and served as a fighter pilot and squadron commander, retiring as a Colonel on February 1, 2026, after 26 years in uniform.
A seventh-generation Texan, he grew up in San Angelo, where he lives with his wife and three daughters.
